issues.description: Constructor mismatch for class GroverTwoQubitWithoutAuxiliaryQubit.__init__: the template defines __init__(self, num_qubits: int) (expects a parameter), whereas the solution implementation and the example usage in the template's run() docstring instantiate the class with no arguments (GroverTwoQubitWithoutAuxiliaryQubit()). This inconsistency will confuse students on how to instantiate the class and will cause their example run() or the provided solution to be inconsistent with the template signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor signatures consistent. Preferred minimal fix: change the template constructor to a no-argument form to match the solution and usage examples (replace def __init__(self, num_qubits: int): with def __init__(self): and keep the internal initialization of number_of_qubits_query_register). Alternatively, update the solution and all usage examples to require and pass num_qubits consistently, but the no-argument constructor is simpler and preserves the current examples.
